outcome: Neural tube defects (NTDs) prevalence in fetal deaths
Proportion of all fetal deaths due to anencephaly
Proportion of all fetal deaths due to myelomeningocele
Risk of fetal death due to anencephaly
Risk of fetal death due to myelomeningocele
cohort: The study analyzed records of fetal deaths in Argentina between 1994 and 2019.
finding: There was a significant decrease in the risk of all fetal deaths due to NTDs, especially anencephaly, in Argentina over the study period, with most reduction observed during the mandatory flour fortification era.
